claims.quote: We left at first light, when the city still smelled of embers and the gulls were too hungry to mind a shipful of men.
Yusuf held the folio like a talisman under his coat, fingers worrying the edge as if he could smooth certainty into it.
Rasim leaned at the wheel and coughed into the back of his sleeve the way a man keeps a small worry to himself.
When I caught his gaze, I felt the amulet at my throat answer him the way a bell answers a hammer: a thin, precise thrum that ran like a wire from skin to bone.
The amulet pricked me, not with a fury but with the patient insistence of a thing doing what it was made to do.

claims.value: handled heavily; coastline softened by smudges; crosses darkened into blurs; pencil lines degrade from confident to scrawl
claims.quote: A smudge had become a thinned scar on the map; fingers had worn confidence away until only a suggestion of land remained.

claims.value: folded smaller and worse for the sea; diagram eaten by a torn edge; words bled at margins and smudged
claims.quote: They traded lines of talk over the folio and the wreck log like sailors trading weather.
I stood on the quarterdeck and watched the hand that was Jarrah draw itself out of the grey, every cove and inlet a small algebra of hazard.
They said the island's name then, but not as a map's point—more as a thing that could hang in the air and wait.

claims.value: intends to keep command and keep crew safe
claims.quote: I had my men to think of, and making a scene would have been the sort of thing that cost a crew its nerve.
Azraq stood aft with the ease of something that does not have to pretend to belong.

claims.value: thrum/pain when bond engaged and when Azraq watches
claims.quote: I felt the amulet thrum again then, a reminder tied to the silver of Azraq's eyes and the Council behind him.

promises.promise: Reader is owed the island's specific navigational coordinates or a committed description of Azraq's long-range watch method if future scenes require them.
promises.quote: Writer note: I have not invented numeric coordinates for Isle Jarrah, nor have I named or attributed a specific peri surveillance technology. If a precise surveillance method or coordinates are required by continuity, they must be recorded explicitly in the state.
